data.name: Lutfiya
data.gender_notes: Lutfiya is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Lutfiya is derived from the Arabic word 'Lutf' which means 'kindness' or 'gentleness'. The name Lutfiya carries the meaning “Kind, Gentle” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Lutfiya usually hope their child will grow to embody kind, gentle and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Lutfiya is often associated with the virtues of compassion, mercy, and understanding.
data.etymology: Lutfiya belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Kind, Gentle.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lutfiya total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: لطفية
in_arabic.meaning: لطفية تعني اللطف و الرقة و الجمال
in_arabic.long_meaning: لطفية هي اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي و تعني اللطف و الرقة و الجمال. و هي مشتقة من الفعل لطف يلطف فهو لطيف و اللطيف هو من أسماء الله الحسنى و هو الذي يلطّف عباده و يرحمهم. و يدل اسم لطفية على الشخصية اللطيفة و الرقيقة و الجميلة.

in_urdu.name: لطفیا
in_urdu.meaning: لطفیا مطلب ہے خوبصورتی، مہربانی، اور خوبی
in_urdu.long_meaning: لطفیا ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے خوبصورتی، مہربانی، اور خوبی۔ یہ نام لطف سے ماخوذ ہے، جو کہ عربی زبان میں مہربانی اور خوبی کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔ یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں بہت اہمیت رکھتا ہے کیونکہ یہ مہربانی اور خوبی کی علامت ہے۔

in_hindi.name: लुत्फिया
in_hindi.meaning: लुत्फिया का अर्थ है सौंदर्य, दयालुता और अच्छाई
in_hindi.long_meaning: लुत्फिया एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है सौंदर्य, दयालुता और अच्छाई। यह नाम लुत्फ से लिया गया है, जो अरबी भाषा में दयालुता और सौंदर्य को दर्शाता है। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में बहुत महत्व रखता है क्योंकि यह दयालुता और सौंदर्य का प्रतीक है।

in_pashto.name: لطفیه
in_pashto.meaning: لطفیه د رحمت، ښکلا، او نیکۍ معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: لطفیه د عربي اصل نوم دی چې د رحمت، ښکلا، او نیکۍ معنی لري. دا نوم د لطف څخه اخیستل شوی دی، کوم چې په عربي ژبه کې د رحمت او ښکلا څرګندوي. دا نوم د افغان او پښتني ټولنې کې ډېر اهمیت لري ځکه چې دا د رحمت او ښکلا نښه ده.

in_english.name: Lutfiya
in_english.meaning: Lutfiya means kindness, beauty, and goodness
in_english.long_meaning: Lutfiya is a feminine given name of Arabic origin, derived from the word 'lutf', which means kindness, beauty, and goodness. It is associated with one of the attributes of Allah, Al-Latif, meaning 'the kind' or 'the gentle'. The name Lutfiya signifies a person with a kind, beautiful, and gentle nature. It holds spiritual significance in Islamic tradition, reflecting the values of compassion and benevolence.

It is a beautiful and meaningful name that embodies the essential qualities of love, affection, and goodwill towards others. In Islamic societies, people with the name Lutfiya are often extolled for their kind and gentle nature as well as their love for humanity and dedication to spreading joy and happiness around them. This can be observed in various aspects of Islamic culture, such as through the songs, stories, or even day-to-day interactions between people.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Lutfiya holds deep significance in the faith of Islam. Lutf symbolizes Allah's love and mercy towards His creation, and being named Lutfiya reminds the bearer of this beautiful connection. By carrying this name, one is encouraged to strive towards embodying the kindness and gentleness of Allah in their daily lives, as well as towards others. This spiritual reminder serves as a constant encouragement to be compassionate and patient, thereby fostering an environment of peace and harmony, which in turn promotes strengthening one's connection with the divine.
